The FloPlast square rainwater diverter in white is a practical solution for efficient rainwater harvesting from downpipes. It is ideal for property maintenance, agricultural applications, and landscaping projects where water conservation is beneficial. This durable white uPVC diverter connects easily to 68mm round and 65mm square downpipes, effectively channelling water into a water butt. Its intelligent design features an overflow prevention mechanism, allowing excess water to bypass the diverter when the butt is full, ensuring continuous drainage. This system offers reliable water management.
